footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income: includes $9.4M from discontinued operations.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. Operating income was $32.1M, up from a $72K loss.
Net income was $33.5M, or $0.96 per share, after a $64.6M loss a year earlier. Operating cash flow was $33.0M and free cash flow $15.7M, versus $11.2M.
sources: Tredegar Corporation Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
